name: Clarissa
source:
She has always cared about her personal image. She tries to act as proper as possible, and look as pretty as she can. Her friendships are thin and might just give way at any moment. unlike the rest of the girls, she doesn't seem to have be changing much as time moves forward. Is it possible she is in fact the least in touch with herself?

[From [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/anticipation-apprehension-adolescence-book-1]IndieDB[/url]]
